result.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, `z.object({ access_token: z.string(), [z.string().toString()]: z.number(), [z.string().optional().toString()]: z.unknown().optional() })` — computed keys call `.toString()` on a ZodString instance, which yields "[object Object]" for both keys, so both collapse to one key and the intended expiry-number enforcement never applies. This is verifiable from the diff alone and breaks the minimum-schema validation for credential-sync mode.
